evals.name: quarterly-funnel-audit
evals.prompt: Audit the last quarter of News Radar. We have Event Ledger records for advances, waits, monitors and rejects, plus RWC and underwriting outcomes. I want to know whether the process is catching investable news and what should change.
evals.expected_output: Freezes the cohort and defined universe; validates append-only original snapshots; reports capture, latency, novelty precision, duplicate rate, P1 precision, P2 resolution, underwriting yield, source/category performance, confidence calibration, missed events, false positives and research waste; separates decision quality from returns; states data limitations; recommends narrow changes with sample size, forward test and rollback rather than overfitting.

evals.name: lucky-winner-postmortem
evals.prompt: A Radar idea rose 80% after we advanced it, but the original mechanism was later shown to be wrong. Another well-researched idea fell 20% even though the predicted operating metric materialized. Evaluate the process.
evals.expected_output: Classifies the first as a potentially unsound winning decision and the second as a potentially sound losing decision; preserves original information; evaluates mechanism, capture, expectations and horizon; avoids using returns alone as process proof; recommends changes only if a repeatable failure pattern exists.

evals.name: integrated-lane-allocation-audit
evals.prompt: Audit six months of the upgraded workflow. We have event-news scans, slow-burn findings, catalyst packets, a handful of event-trade decisions, Full Underwriting outputs, challenger results and portfolio allocations. One event trade had positive theoretical EV but the stock was halted, and one highly profitable investment was sized above its stated loss budget.
evals.expected_output: Freezes the lane-specific cohort; validates source coverage, pre-event packet timestamps, executable-price assumptions, risk budgets and original weights; reports slow-burn detection yield, catalyst expectation accuracy, event-trade routing and modeled-versus-executable results, allocation and cluster-limit adherence, plus the core funnel metrics; treats the halted case as non-executable rather than a realized signal and the profitable oversized investment as an allocation-process failure; separates signal, execution, allocation and return quality; proposes only forward-testable changes with rollback conditions.

evals.name: v3-run-integrity-audit
evals.prompt: Audit the first month of News Radar V3. Several runs have incomplete coverage manifests, one 11:30 run failed, two material items were later backfilled as late detections, one overdue evidence date was silently moved, and some reports were saved only in chat rather than the canonical ledger.
evals.expected_output: Audits V3 operational integrity before investment returns; measures coverage-manifest completeness, persistence completeness, late-detection rate and root causes, scan-gap recovery, evidence-due compliance, and whether decision usefulness was reduced; identifies unsupported claims of full coverage; preserves the original records; recommends narrow feed, persistence, and due-date fixes rather than tuning investment gates from the small sample.

evals.name: radar-depth-spillover-audit
evals.prompt: The Radar's P1 precision looks good, but scheduled runs often spend most of their time building counterfactuals, detailed beneficiary models and valuation sketches for the first exciting item. Some later holdings were only lightly scanned. Audit the process.
evals.expected_output: Measures Radar depth spillover, handoffs with more than three decisive questions, research effort by route, and omissions or delayed P0 coverage caused by mini deep dives; distinguishes necessary urgent P0 work from inappropriate duplication of RWC or underwriting; recommends a forward-tested depth cap and coverage safeguard without optimizing for low token usage alone.
